# laravelforge_site_domain_configuration (Data Source)

Fetches the DNS configuration instructions for a Laravel Forge site domain record: the read-only list of DNS records the user must create to verify and route the domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_record_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the domain record to fetch DNS configuration for.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site the domain record belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `configurations` (Attributes List) DNS records to apply for the domain record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configurations))

<a id="nestedatt--configurations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configurations`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the DNS record.
- `ttl` (Number) The recommended TTL (Time to Live) for the DNS record, in seconds.
- `type` (String) The type of DNS record (`A`, `CNAME`, or `TXT`).
- `value` (String) The value (IP address, CNAME target, TXT value) of the DNS record.
